newsitem.title: JAPAN: Korea Container plans to launch samurai - sources.
newsitem.headline: Korea Container plans to launch samurai - sources.

text.p: Korea Container Terminal Co of South Korea is planning to launch five billion yen worth of samurai bonds in October, underwriting sources in Tokyo said on Tuesday.

Kokusai Securities will lead manage Korea Container's samurai bond issue, which will have a duration of five years, they said. It will be the first time that Kokusai has acted as a lead manager in this type of bond launching.
A meeting between investors and Korea Container is scheduled on October 4 at Kokusai Securities.
